one_line_bio: A Jaipur-made ethnic wear label whose styling reels and new-arrival carousels are carrying the account, while sale posts and greeting posts drag it down.
account_summary: Demo Ethnic Wear Co. has 48.2K followers and posts handmade kurtas and festive wear. Across 110 recent posts its average engagement rate is 2.92%, which counts as strong for its size. The median is only 1.74%, so a handful of breakout posts (13 posts reached more than 3× the median) are lifting the average. About 55% of the feed is reels, and reels reach 68% of the follower count on average. Posting is irregular at 1.6 posts a week, with gaps of up to 12 days.
niche: Handmade Indian ethnic wear (kurtas, festive collections) for urban working women
target_audience_guess: Women aged 22–38 in Indian metros who wear ethnic wear to the office and for festivals and shop on Instagram from a link in bio
brand_voice: Warm and conversational, with light humour in POV reels and craft pride in behind-the-scenes posts. Captions are short (58 characters on average) and use few hashtags (2 per post).

hook_analysis: The best-performing openers promise something useful right away ("3 ways to style…") or start a familiar situation ("POV: …"). Behind-the-scenes reels open on the process with no stated payoff, which is probably why they underperform even though the craft story is strong. Sale and greeting posts have no hook at all.
posting_behaviour: Posts mostly go out at noon IST. The data shows 6–7 PM performs best (4.0% ER at 18:00, 3.7% at 19:00), and 9 AM performs worst (1.6%). Saturday is the best day (3.58%) and Tuesday the weakest (2.04%). Cadence is uneven: the average gap is 4.4 days, the longest is 12.4 days, and the consistency score is 57/100.
what_works: Styling reels: 4.78% ER, the best content on the account
New-arrival carousels: 4.30% ER. Carousels overall (3.14%) nearly match reels (3.37%)
Reels get strong distribution: on average they reach views equal to 68% of the follower count
Momentum is up: ER over the last 30 days is 8.1%, compared with 2.2% in the 30 days before
what_doesnt_work: Greeting posts like "Happy Independence Day": 0.89% ER, about a third of the average
Single images overall: 1.13% ER, under half of reels and carousels
Posting at 9 AM and 8 PM, which both come in under 1.8% ER
Behind-the-scenes reels that show the craft without a hook or a payoff
gaps_and_opportunities: No series format. A recurring "Office look of the week" built on the top pillar would make posting regular
The craft story (Jaipur block print) is under-used. Add a hook and an outcome so it performs
Customer posts are under-used: turn UGC into try-on reels instead of repost carousels
Comments are low (2.9 per 100 likes). Captions rarely ask a question or prompt a reply
No creator collaborations or sponsored posts in the period analysed

recommendations.title: Make styling reels the backbone
recommendations.why: This is the best pillar at 4.78% ER, yet only 17% of posts.
recommendations.how: Post 2 styling reels a week (office, wedding guest, college) with the payoff in the first 2 seconds.

recommendations.title: Move posting to 6–7 PM, and post on Saturday
recommendations.why: 18:00 gets 4.0% ER versus 3.3% at the current usual time of noon.
recommendations.how: Schedule the main reel at 6:30 PM IST. Keep Saturday for the strongest piece of the week.

recommendations.title: Drop plain greeting and sale images
recommendations.why: They score 0.9–1.5% ER and teach the algorithm that the audience skips the account.
recommendations.how: Turn sales into a "3 looks under ₹1,500" reel and festivals into a styled-look carousel.

recommendations.title: Fix the behind-the-scenes hook
recommendations.why: The craft content is the brand's moat but sits at 2.2% ER.
recommendations.how: Open with the finished kurta, then show "how 1 kurta takes 4 days". Add a counter or reveal at the end.

recommendations.title: Post at a steady rhythm
recommendations.how: Fix a 4-posts-a-week rhythm: 2 reels, 1 carousel, 1 UGC or try-on post.

recommendations.title: Ask for comments
recommendations.why: The account gets only 2.9 comments per 100 likes.
recommendations.how: End captions with an either/or question ("Office or brunch?"), and pin a reply.

posting_plan: 4 posts a week at 6:30 PM IST: Mon styling reel, Wed new-arrival carousel, Thu craft or UGC reel, Sat strongest reel of the week. No plain greeting or sale images; turn those into styled content.
sales_pitch_summary: Your account already engages well for its size (2.9% average ER), but most of that comes from a few breakout posts. Styling reels and new-arrival carousels perform up to 1.6× your average, yet they are less than a third of what you post, while greeting and sale images sit at under 1.5%. Posting at 6–7 PM and keeping a steady 4-a-week rhythm alone should lift results. We would build a recurring styling series, re-hook your Jaipur craft story, and turn customer photos into try-on reels, with a monthly report against these same benchmarks.
